column1: # kit #7 tests track (vita/notes/kit7-tests.md "Recorded replay fixtures"): the recorded sessions replayed headless on the Mac null backend
# after every build (run-fixtures.sh), each with per-frame STATE checksums (Diag/StateHash.cs) and per-frame render-stream hashes
# (SHEPHERD_STREAM_HASH), failing on the first mismatch. Columns (TAB): name, frames, pack (menu = runtime/vitapack/menu, card = the kit
# owner folder's pack, intro = the kit #4 intro pack; FIXTURE_PACK_<NAME> overrides), pad file (pads/, vita/v6/ or -), extra env, what it is.
# Every fixture also runs with the test-only determinism switches SHEPHERD_TEST_ASTAR=join and SHEPHERD_TEST_SPINE=join (frame clock):
# the game's two worker threads (A* paths, Spine's dispatch thread) otherwise make routes with pathing / skeleton readers host-timing
# dependent (the combat flake); on the menu and New Game routes they change no frame (checked: kit7-tests.md).
